brief: Goldman Sachs FICC and Equities (Faris Mourad) argues for buying the dip in AI infrastructure. The chain: the momentum factor basket GSPRHIMO has sold off more than 20 percentage points in a week, past the desk's own short term expectation of a summer slump, which has left hyperscaler (GSXUHYPR) and data center equipment (GSTMTDAT) valuations near liberation day lows and near 2-year lows. Positioning fell with it. Aggregate net exposure in US data center names is at its lowest since early Q1 and Mag7 gross and net exposures sit only modestly above 3-year lows. Because those two baskets have low correlation to momentum, the desk says buying them is both cheap and a balance to overall momentum exposure. It frames the call ahead of an earnings season that follows historic beats from MU and Samsung (005930) and META's cloud business launch announcement. The rest is a valuation survey by sub-basket: other semis show the same divergence between net earnings and market cap, optical networks and liquid cooling price in further growth, independent power producers trade in line with earnings expectations but look cheap overall, grid infrastructure prices in further growth, and AI software stays depressed.
